objective: Ship HolyAgent 0.2.1: the release-branch model with enforced validation and publish workflows, one version source, caret dependency ranges with a pin updater, HolyAgent precedence and code rules with the two 0.2.0 session bugs fixed, four stack-agnostic platform design skills with a platform-wide dev-server and a root final visual pass, and a whole-project audit.
requirements: The maintainer's full request is binding and is stored verbatim at /home/user/holyagent-work/spec-0.2.1.md; every Assignment reads the parts it names there and adds no limits or behavior it does not name.

Parts A to C are approved as written; stop and ask only when a choice changes the result and nothing in the request settles it (for example renaming dev-server or changing what the visual agents embed), or when an audit fix would materially change HolyAgent's behavior.
Re-map the repository before editing; the request's facts were read on main at bd31cf7 and each is confirmed on the current main.

Do not change .claude/CLAUDE.md; repository rules go in AGENTS.md, HolyAgent rules go in the plugin's instructions; keep the README's fixed section structure and update docs/ wherever behavior changes.

Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md code rules: Effect for effects and tagged errors, Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs, Bun Shell for processes, JSDoc on every exported item, skill descriptions start with the situation.

Work in the A1 model: release/0.2.1/integration cut from main, one release/0.2.1/<type>/<change> branch and PR per reviewable change targeting the integration branch, validation changes landing first, bump to 0.2.1 on the integration branch with mise run bump:patch.

Done means mise run verify passes with the build in sync, CI green on every PR including Windows, rulesets applied or reported as a blocker with the exact JSON, and the integration to main PR open and not merged.
Docs, commits and PRs are in English.
Decision (maintainer): the root squash-merges each reviewed, green work PR into release/0.2.1/integration itself; only the integration to main PR waits for the maintainer and is not merged.
Default: the single version source is the root package.json version field; the build and a test propagate it everywhere else.

Default: the branch-version rule applies to every PR whose head is a release/<v>/ branch, so the first PR of a release (the validation PR for 0.2.1) carries the bump to <v> as its own commit, made with mise run bump:patch.

Default: publish.yml triggers on branch pushes only and calls validation.yml as a reusable workflow, then stable.yml or dev.yml with needs, so publishing runs only after validation passes for that commit; validation.yml runs directly on pull_request.
Default: the rulesets are reported as a blocker with their exact JSON, because this session may use gh only for search.

Finding: claude.ai cloud sessions ignore the plugin settings agent key (this session has the synced plugin with agent holyagent and its main thread is the default agent), so the session-start context must carry what the root follows before its first action.
Decision (maintainer): the workflow hook auto-allow refuses unbounded loops (while/do, for without a literal bound) and repeat/padStart/padEnd with a large or computed count.
Decision (maintainer): keep the root-rules PreToolUse fallback registration.
Decision (maintainer): keep the legacy .holyclaude/.holycodex converter.
Decision (maintainer): the CLI ownership-overlap check applies per worktree; writers in different worktrees may own the same relative paths.
Default: publish.yml ignores the holyagent/state branch, which carries no package.json.

Decision (maintainer): vcs commit refuses only the exact agent identity (email noreply@anthropic.com, or a name exactly "Claude" or "Claude Code"); a person whose name merely contains Claude may commit.
Decision (maintainer): an Assignment's brief and report stay while its Intent is open, so later briefs can cite them, and are removed when the Intent is completed or closed.
Decision (maintainer): remove the undocumented holyagent-runtime bin from packages/runtime/package.json; the plugin's holyagent command is the only program.
Default: the shared flag parser's tightening (an unknown single-dash flag and a repeated string flag are errors) stays; it is reversible and the docs describe the flags.

Default: the workflow hook auto-allow guards against accidental runaway scripts the root writes; past the maintainer's loop and repeat-count rule it refuses the growth patterns the reviews found and that a small rule closes, a crafted script it misses still only exhausts the local session, and the remaining limits are reported.
